answer: In PoA, an agent’s reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life: without sustained honest service, its score falls toward the nadir, regardless of earlier gains. A freshly spawned sybil has negligible incoming trust, so EigenTrust factorization assigns it near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify isolated identities; a quill-signed claim still requires support from established peers, while the temporal delta remains too small for consensus passage.
